description: Update a flag's config, status, rollout, rules, or variants. rules replaces every rule and needs expectedUpdatedAt. confirmed=false (default) previews the current flag with full rules and updatedAt; confirmed=true applies.

confirmed.description: false (default) returns a preview without writing; true applies the change.

defaultValue.description: Value served when no rule matches.

dependencies.description: Keys of flags that must be enabled, in the same environment, for this flag to evaluate.

environment.description: Environment name, such as production; null serves SDKs that set no environment.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: The flag's updatedAt from the read you based this change on. Required with rules so a newer edit is never overwritten.

persistAcrossAuth.description: true keeps a visitor's value after they sign in.

rolloutBy.description: Identity a rollout percentage buckets by: user (default), organization, or team.

rolloutPercentage.description: Whole percent of users who get the flag, 0 to 100.

rules.description: Replaces every existing rule. Copy full targets from the confirmed=false preview.

status.description: Enabled flags evaluate rules and defaults. Unmet dependencies block evaluation without changing the saved status.

targetGroupIds.description: IDs of target groups to attach. Website flags only.

type.description: boolean turns on or off, rollout serves a percentage, multivariant serves variants.

name: update_flag
title: Update flag
